origin: Source inspection, native object diagnostics and incremental rebuilds
observations: lcdkit_probe is retained as platform_driver.probe after platform_driver_register; it explicitly returns -EPROBE_DEFER. Discarding its __init code is unsafe for later retry.
hisi_pll_unlock_probe is a persistent platform-driver callback and calls hs_clk_base, whose code was marked __init.
Removing the two __init annotations retains code without suppressing modpost checks. The complete Halium native rebuild passed and section mismatches fell from 32 to 30.
assembly_interpretation: The six failed CRCs correspond to weak CRC declarations in shipped assembly with absent same-name C files. This does not establish ABI/layout compatibility of the pre-generated assembly with changed configurations. No CRC is invented and the assembly is unchanged.

duplicate_export_object_confirmation.method: AArch64 nm -A on all three compiled platform oam_log.o files; exact __ksymtab_g_ast_tx_complete_stat matches
duplicate_export_object_confirmation.scope: Compiled candidate objects only; no active-phone-chip inference
